Direct homomorphism enumeration, pair commutation, and actual generated-subgroup tests in verify.py corroborate the formulas; universality rests on the proof.

value.rationale: The exact all-arity probability of random automorphism generation is a natural quantitative invariant, across all field sizes and algebra dimensions, and identifies a sharp extension-degree resonance with unbounded generator-rank changes in characteristic two. The odd-characteristic higher-rank example and conjugacy class spectrum strengthen the structural content. This is motivated by the classical nilpotent evolution-algebra automorphism problem and is more than an arbitrary small finite computation. General group-theoretic ingredients are credited.
